review_findings.finding: Borrowing created cash without linked debt service and claims.
review_findings.resolution: Reject every nonzero borrowing input until a separately validated financing schedule exists.

review_findings.finding: Growing total terminal FCFE conflicted with constant financing interest.
review_findings.resolution: Value growing pre-interest operating equity cash and constant after-tax interest separately.

review_findings.finding: Blank and domain guards did not protect all dependent outputs.
review_findings.resolution: Guard selected inputs, dates, sensitivities and terminal cash; bank selectors and supporting outputs; scope-compatible Unilever TTM and margins. 122 mutation checks recorded.

review_findings.finding: Rounded USD3.6bn debt was treated as exact USD3600m principal.
review_findings.resolution: Record December 2025 detailed USD3550m note principal and distinguish dates, carrying values and cash interest.

review_findings.finding: Known ownership evidence omitted from uncertainty assessment.
review_findings.resolution: Record July outstanding shares and December disclosed awards. Mixed-date EPS proxy explicitly remains unapproved as a current claim count.

review_findings.finding: Ownership sensitivity and bank capital comparison exceeded their scope.
review_findings.resolution: Restrict 5% ownership scaling to zero fixed-cash buybacks; attribute Advanced versus Standardized total-capital comparison precisely.
335.989m is explicitly July outstanding plus June EPS awards; December note principal is separately dated.

review_findings.finding: Sensitivity cells lacked positive terminal-FCFE checks at each growth setting.
review_findings.resolution: Each grid cell validates its own terminal cash, rate domains and active inputs; targeted negative-terminal fixture passes.

review_findings.finding: Invalid JPM selector could error or truncate fractional values.
review_findings.resolution: Require a numeric integer in 1..4 before CHOOSE; blank, zero, negative, 5, fractional and text cases withheld.

review_findings.finding: Missing quote broke workbook case and artifact validation.
review_findings.resolution: Support WITHHELD price-dependent returns while retaining conditional valuation arithmetic. Actual no-quote export/import fixture validated.

review_findings.finding: Bank helper bypassed finite/non-boolean numeric validation.
review_findings.resolution: Validate all bank numeric inputs; NaN, infinity, boolean and invalid domains rejected.

review_findings.finding: XIRR fixed lower bound could report an incorrect near-total-loss return.
review_findings.resolution: Solve in log(1+r), validate bracketing and residual; extreme-loss and unrepresentable-loss tests added.

continuation: Create a new research revision to replace illustrative maturity, reconcile lease/cash financing and latest-disclosed claims, bridge the historical cutoff, and independently corroborate conclusions. Focused audit is complete.
model_identity: Current chat model configuration not independently verified; do not claim these pilots ran on 6.1 Sol High.
conclusion_limits: Mature reinvestment and margin persistence unsupported.
Lease/cash-interest financing and current ownership claim reconciliation incomplete.
June-to-October cash/operating bridge and independent valuation corroboration incomplete.
Intrinsic value, investment judgement, accepted prospective returns and actionable entries withheld; displayed numbers are conditional arithmetic illustrations.
